name: Momiji
message: 「Oh, Teacher. How was Asahi doing？」
I had been with Asahi after her loss for a while, but since Momiji had a match coming up, I returned to the venue.

name: Iori
message: 「You already knew the result?」

name: Momiji
message: 「Well, all the match results from the preliminaries get reflected in the academy’s system in real-time, you know.」

name: Iori
message: 「You’ve got quite the composure, watching stuff like that right before your own match.」

name: Iori
message: 「Your opponent is Victoria, after all.」
Indeed, Momiji’s opponent was the current Toujinegi and the top favorite to win this year’s tournament, Victoria.

name: Momiji
message: 「Forget about me. Was Asahi doing okay？」

name: Iori
message: 「Yeah, she was smiling and saying, ‘Don’t worry about me.’ She was frustrated, but she wasn’t depressed.」

name: Iori
message: 「Still, Asahi is the type to bottle things up. I’m worried she might be brooding over it deep down.」

name: Iori
message: 「If there’s anything I can do to help her, even a little, I really want to do whatever I can...」

name: Momiji
message: 「You’re such a softie, Teacher.」
As I sank into thought, Momiji waved her hand as if to cheer me up instead.

name: Momiji
message: 「Asahi understands your feelings better than anyone. Even if you don’t say a word, it all gets through to her.」

name: Momiji
message: 「So, just having those feelings is enough, Teacher.」

name: Iori
message: 「I wonder if that’s true...」

name: Momiji
message: 「It is, it is.」

name: Momiji
message: 「It’s okay, Asahi is really strong. She isn’t the type to fall apart just because of one loss.」

name: Iori
message: 「...You’re right. I’ll believe in Asahi’s strength.」

name: Momiji
message: 「That’s the spirit. Nothing’s going to start if you’re the one worrying yourself sick.」

name: Iori
message: 「Thanks, Momiji. It feels like you ended up cheering me up instead.」

name: Momiji
message: 「Roles reversed, is that it？」

name: Iori
message: 「Haha, I guess so. I need to get it together more.」
Even while she claims to prefer being alone and says this and that, Momiji keeps a close eye on her classmates.

name: Momiji
message: 「Ah, though, you’ll at least have to go cheer Asahi up one more time, Teacher.」

name: Iori
message: 「What do you mean？」

name: Momiji
message: 「Even if Asahi makes it to the finals of the Martial Festival—I’m the one who’s going to win.」
With a laugh and a quip, Momiji stepped onto the stage.
……As she stepped onto the stage, she was met with cheers.
Even though it’s just the qualifiers, there’s a decent crowd.
Well, I suppose that’s to be expected. I’m a Suzakuin, and my opponent is the reigning Toujinegi.

name: Victoria
message: 「Haaai！ Everyone, let’s get this party started！」
That reigning Toujinegi responded to the cheers by waving both hands wildly, twirling around in high spirits.

name: Victoria
message: 「Fufuuh, it really is the best being watched by everyone！ Very exciting！」

name: Momiji
message: 「You’re as energetic as ever, Victoria-san.」

name: Victoria
message: 「Energetic, energetic！ I’m always full of energy！ Yay！ Woohoo！ Yeah！」

name: Momiji
message: 「……Let me correct myself. You’re even more energetic than usual.」

name: Victoria
message: 「Of course！ The festival is finally starting, so it’d be a waste not to get hyped up！」

name: Momiji
message: 「You seem to be in good form. I believe you’ve been undefeated so far?」

name: Victoria
message: 「Yes！ But Suzakuin-chan, you’re not doing so bad yourself, right？」

name: Momiji
message: 「Yes, I intend to remain undefeated until I win the main tournament.」

name: Victoria
message: 「Ahahaha, that’s just like you, Suzakuin-chan！ But, I won’t lose either！」

name: Victoria
message: 「Come to think of it, when we sparred before, didn’t it end halfway through？」

name: Momiji
message: 「That’s true. There won’t be any interruptions this time, so let’s settle the score properly.」

name: Momiji
message: 「You said back then that you’d ‘win the Martial Festival with ease.’ I expect to see that strength today.」

name: Victoria
message: 「Did I say that~？ Oh well, yeah, yeah, I’ll win with ease~, ahahaha！」

name: Momiji
message: 「……I, see.」
Is this person completely hopeless at everything except Jindou…….

name: Victoria
message: 「But well, it’s still just the qualifiers, huh~. It’d get me even more hyped if it were the main tournament~」

name: Momiji
message: 「I’ll have you know, I’m going all out.」

name: Victoria
message: 「Yes！ Of course！ I don’t intend to hold back either！」

name: Umpire
message: 「Alright, both combatants, take your stances！」
At the signal from the Umpire, I drew my beloved blade, Tsubakuro Nagamitsu.
Victoria-san is still smiling as usual, but the mere act of her taking a stance increases the pressure immensely——

name: Umpire
message: 「……Begin！」
At the signal to begin the match, I’m the first to make a move.
I start with a probe; from the very edge of my range, I repeat quick, light strikes aimed at the torso to gauge her reaction.
Victoria parries them just as lightly, her defense barely making contact with the tips of our blades.
Well, that much is to be expected.

name: Momiji
message: （Next, a low strike……！）

name: Victoria
message: 「Whoa！ That didn’t hit！」
I lower my body, stepping in even deeper than before to aim an attack at her feet.
She avoids it by lifting one leg.

name: Momiji
message: 「Not yet……！」
From there, I whip my blade upwards in one fluid motion.

name: Victoria
message: 「Wow！ But that’s no good either！」
It’s a low, difficult attack to parry, but she stops that too.
……For some reason, while still standing on one leg.

name: Victoria
message: 「Then, I guess it’s my turn now~！」

name: Momiji
message: 「No, it’s still mine.」
I immediately strike at her remaining supporting leg, but Victoria nimbly hops on one foot while batting my blade away.

name: Victoria
message: 「Oh！ That’s pretty cheap！ When does my turn get to come！？」

name: Momiji
message: 「It won’t. I’m going to end this with a one-turn kill！」

name: Momiji
message: （Need to kick it up… kick it up another gear……！）
Victoria has both feet on the ground now, but I dive in with a low posture, aiming for her feet once again.

name: Victoria
message: 「Muu, playing solitaire while in a match is frowned upon, you know！」
I dodge the counter she swings down at me, feinting by shifting my body to the side.
The moment I see her eyes follow the fake—I strike！

name: Victoria
message: 「Whoa, that was close！ I thought I’d fallen for it！」

name: Momiji
message: 「So you didn’t fall for it.」
I thought I’d caught her with the feint, but Victoria had blocked it perfectly.
And what’s more, she grinned.

name: Victoria
message: 「Nah, honestly, I did fall for it.」

name: Victoria
message: 「But I’ve studied Suzakuin’s sword style！ I just thought, ‘If it’s Suzakuin, she’s gotta be going for this side！’」

name: Momiji
message: 「My sword style…… I see, so it was Minamoto-senpai.」

name: Victoria
message: 「Yes！ Thanks to Shizuku, I’m perfectly prepared for this！」
It’s true that if it were Minamoto―senpai, she would be able to trace the lines of my sword. If she used that to prepare, it would indeed be quite troublesome―
Or so it seems, but in reality, it doesn't bother me that much.
No, if anything, it might even be advantageous.

name: Momiji
message: （Even if she spent until the very last minute thinking of countermeasures, that only applies to the version of me from yesterday）
The me of yesterday was stronger than the day before—and the me of today is stronger than yesterday！

name: Momiji
message: （If you prepared based on the weakling I was back then, you're going to have a hard time dealing with the me who has grown stronger！）

name: Victoria
message: 「Then it’s finally my turn—！」

name: Momiji
message: 「I never declared a turn end！」

name: Victoria
message: 「Whoa！？ You’re still coming！？」

name: Momiji
message: 「Of course I am！」
I use a diagonal slash from the upper position as a feint, then turn the blade to swing upward from below.
This is the sword style I’ve used until now. That’s why Victoria-san defends against it so easily.
But from here—！

name: Victoria
message: 「Whoa！ That was close！」

name: Victoria
message: 「Whoa-oa, that’s seriously dangeeerous！」
I follow up my speed-enhanced slashes to the left and right with an immediate sweep.
She barely manages to block these as well, but it was a very close call.
In other words, just as I thought！

name: Momiji
message: （I just need to surpass the sword style of my former self！）

name: Victoria
message: 「Eek！」
A blow incorporating feints with my eyes, my body, and minute movements slashes across Victoria-san’s torso.
My sword speed and body movement have undoubtedly improved. Previous countermeasures won't keep up with this.

name: Victoria
message: 「Suzakuin-chan, you really are amazing！ It’s totally different from when it was Shizuku！」
Victoria-san says this while leaping back, yet she still sounds energetic.
To be completely unfazed like that—as expected of her.

name: Momiji
message: 「From here on out, you’ll see even more of me that doesn't fit your countermeasures.」
I reset my stance and just as I moved to attack in one go—

name: Shizuku
message: 「Vicky！ Switch to Plan B！」

name: Victoria
message: 「Plan B！ Yes, got it！」

name: Momiji
message: 「Plan B...？」
Instructions flew in from Minamoto-senpai at the side of the stage. I braced myself, on high alert.

name: Victoria
message: 「Heh-heh-heh. Shizu taught me that you can’t just rely on one countermeasure, you know~」

name: Momiji
message: （I see… Victoria is the same, but Minamoto-senpai is even more unpredictable than her）

name: Victoria
message: 「Here I come！ Counter-Suzakuin, Plan B！」
Did she really need to shout that like a special move—
While I was thinking that, Victoria lunged in all at once.

name: Victoria
message: 「Hiyah-hiyah-hiyahhh！」
Regardless, I fend off the attacks being unleashed.
Dodging, parrying, and blocking; I repel every blade coming at me from the left and right.
The attacks are as heavy as ever, but—in other words, this is something I’ve taken before.
She’s just swinging at me with full force like usual, and it doesn't seem like anything has changed—but.

name: Momiji
message: （What is this… there’s some strange feeling of unease…）

name: Victoria
message: 「Yahoooo！ Take thisss！！」
Even while I’m occupied with doubt, Victoria continues to unleash attacks one after another.
Each blow is a wide swing, yet I feel like her sword speed has increased somehow.
—No, not just her sword speed, maybe her overall speed.
Thanks to that, even now, while I’m purely on the defensive, there were times when my blocks almost didn’t make it in time.

name: Victoria
message: 「Hya-haaa！ This is so fuuun！！！」

name: Momiji
message: （Did she reallocate her Tenju toward speed？ Or is the Plan B suggestion itself a fake—？）
As I turn these thoughts over in my mind, I observe her movements in detail.
Victoria is still swinging wide, her attacks so defenseless it’s hard to believe she’s the current Toujinegi—

name: Momiji
message: （…Defenseless？）

name: Victoria
message: 「CHESTOOOOOO！！！」
I parry the blow struck from overhead and switch positions.
At that moment, Victoria’s body was completely defenseless. Furthermore—

name: Victoria
message: 「Let’s go all out！ Let’s keep pushing！！」
None of her attacks seem to take defense into account at all.

name: Momiji
message: （Is this a trap？ No, but such a blatant one…）
While staying vigilant—I’ll just aim for a counter in time with her next attack！

name: Victoria
message: 「Terya-rya-rya-ahhh！」

name: Momiji
message: 「There！」

name: Momiji
message: 「Wh-what, she blocked it…！？」
I didn’t think she would defend.
I thought the attack was coming, but Victoria stopped her feet at the last second and caught my strike.

name: Momiji
message: （Did I lose the reading？ No, this is……）

name: Victoria
message: 「Let’s go, go go go！！！！」
While I was stunned, a flurry of strikes was unleashed immediately. I barely managed to dodge, and created some distance.
I call out to Victoria as she bears down on me. Trepidatiously, and with a bad feeling.

name: Momiji
message: 「Victoria… what are you thinking about right now？」

name: Victoria
message: 「Hmm？ I’m not thinking about a-ny-thing！」

name: Victoria
message: 「If I had to say, I’m just enjoying the moment to the max！！」
I barely manage to catch the attack Victoria launched as she dove in while speaking, just in the nick of time.
Heavy, and fast—no, that’s not it. It’s certainly heavy, but I’ve realized the true nature of why it feels fast.

name: Momiji
message: （Could it be… is this the 'state of Shohou Muga' that Master was talking about…！？）』
Non-attachment. Moving the body through sensation, not thought.
Severing actions from the basis of thought, and simply accepting the phenomena that occur.
Becoming one with all creation, the zenith of philosophy—
Something I could never have done, yet Victoria was pulling it off with ease…！

name: Momiji
message: （Is this the gap between the current Toujinegi and me…！？）

name: Victoria
message: 「Yahoooo！！！」
While parrying Victoria’s heavy attacks, I grit my teeth at something else entirely.
She had easily demonstrated before me something I could never attain.
And she claims this is Plan B, her next-best option. I wish she’d quit the jokes.

name: Momiji
message: （Then I’ll just have to…！）
I frantically try to erase my thoughts.
…Non-attachment. Aiming for that zenith, I strike out blindly without thinking of anything！

name: Victoria
message: 「Let’s have more, more fun！」

name: Momiji
message: 「Gghaaa！？」
Well, I tried it, but… she dodged it easily and I took a counter head-on, rolling across the ground.

name: Momiji
message: （It’s impossible after all！ Fighting without thinking is absolutely impossible！）
I don’t know what I’m supposed to do. If you don’t think, this is what happens normally.
How is Victoria able to do such a thing? And to begin with, how did she even reach that state—

name: Victoria
message: 「Yahoo！ Here I come, way-way！！」

name: Momiji
message: （…Geez, could it be that the state of Shohou Muga is just a hair’s breadth away from being an idiot…？）
Seeing Victoria frolicking around, I can’t help but feel there’s something not quite right about this.

name: Momiji
message: （No... well, whatever... Regardless, I can't afford to lose here！）
Even if it’s just the qualifiers, I don't want to lose; nor do I want to lose to the technique I couldn't master myself.
And above all, I don't want to lose to Victoria！

name: Iori
message: 「...Heh, that's an interesting strategy.」
Right now, Victoria is moving purely on intuition.
Movements with so many random elements are a bad match for Momiji, who relies on her genius-level reading ability and tactics based on that.
Now, if you ask if everyone should fight that way, that is absolutely not the case.
If anyone other than Victoria tried that, they would be easily crushed by Momiji's slashes.
In fact, Victoria has taken Momiji's attacks again and again.
If you wonder why she’s fine, it’s because she has more Barrier Jackets than anyone else.
Some degree of damage is within her calculations; it’s a brute-force approach only someone like Victoria could pull off.

name: Iori
message: （I see, Plan B. It’s the ultimate countermeasure against Momiji.）
To think that Shizuku, a student, came up with this and even coached Victoria so she could pull it off—it’s frightening to contemplate.
I wanted her for the Martial Arts Division, but she undoubtedly has incredible latent talent for the Technical Division as well.

name: Iori
message: （The teachers over there must find her a rewarding student to teach！）
This academy is a treasure trove of talent.
Everywhere I look, whoever I see, they are brimming with brilliance. Thinking that, my heart can't help but race.

name: Victoria
message: 「Right then, here I go！ Listen up and watch close！ You wicked, disrespectful, good-for-nothing scoundrels who dare defy the Shogun-sama！」

name: Iori
message: 「Wait, this ritual chant is...！」
While I was impressed, Victoria was already taking a stance for her finishing move.
Is she trying to end the match this early? Perhaps this is Shizuku's call, too.
In fact, Momiji seems to still be bewildered by Plan B Victoria.

name: Victoria
message: 「How’s this for a change of pace... Six Katanas！！」
Victoria's blade splits into six. All directed at Momiji.

name: Victoria
message: 「Go！ Profound Phantasm, Sonic Rush！！」

name: Momiji
message: 「Guhhh！」
A three-stage—no, a high-speed six-stage thrust after easily slipping into the reach of her long sword.
Although Momiji managed to fend off the first three, she took a direct hit from almost all of the ones that followed.

name: Momiji
message: 「Ngh, hah... so it isn't always just three, is it.」
Momiji, pulling far back to catch her breath.
For Momiji, who prioritizes offense and speed over defense, unavoidable attacks like that might be one of her natural nemeses.
If she keeps getting hit with that over and over, Momiji won't be able to hold out, and she'll lose—

name: Iori
message: （...Victoria-san has Shizuku-san as her Second, so it should be fine for me to lend a little support too.）
With that in mind, I hurried over to get close to Momiji.

name: Iori
message: 「...Momiji, can you hear me！」

name: Momiji
message: 「...What is it?」
Without sparing me a glance, Momiji kept her eyes locked on Victoria-san, yet she still answered.

name: Iori
message: 「Here's some advice from your Sensei, and I'll make it quick. Listen up—go for a one-hit knockout！」

name: Iori
message: 「Her guard is thinning out. Shave away the rest of her Barrier Jacket with a sure-hit strike！」

name: Iori
message: 「Don't worry, Momiji—you can do it！」

name: Momiji
message: 「...Heh, roger that！」
Momiji reset her stance and fixed an even sharper gaze on her opponent.

name: Momiji
message: （Honestly... Sensei really is such a worrywart.）
Sensei gave me that advice—but I'd already thought of that much myself.
So as advice, it was completely meaningless.

name: Momiji
message: （...Still, I guess it worked, huh?）
The fact that Sensei is giving his all thinking about me, believing in my victory. That alone just makes me so happy.
Knowing that Sensei has my back fills me with courage and strength.

name: Momiji
message: （Though maybe that disqualifies me as a Suzakuin？）
As that thought crosses my mind, a smile slips out despite myself.

name: Momiji
message: （Hey, this is no time to be smiling, though...！）
Still, after being shown that kind of trust, I can't afford to lose now more than ever.
I'll definitely win. I'll prove it. For my own sake, and for Sensei's.

name: Spectator B
message: 「Over here, over here, hurry！」

name: Spectator D
message: 「Thank goodness, it's not over yet！」
Suddenly—voices like that reached my ears.
Glancing briefly around, I saw the crowd had grown before I knew it.

name: Victoria
message: 「Whoa！ We've got a crowd gathering！」
The fairly sizable crowd that had already been here swelled until the place was packed.
People whose matches had already finished, along with those who'd been cheering them on, must've gathered over here.
Probably trying to gather intel with the main tournament in mind, the newcomers stared intently, determined not to miss a single move.

name: Victoria
message: 「Yeehaaaw! Now I'm getting pumped up!」
In contrast to me, who could only manage a wry smile, Victoria seemed excited.

name: Victoria
message: 「Aaaalright！ Let's make this match even hotter and more excellent, Suzakuin！」

name: Momiji
message: 「Indeed, I'm starting to get fired up myself. Though—it might not last very long.」

name: Victoria
message: 「Eeeeh, that would be a bummer！ So you'd better hold your ground, Suzakuin！！」

name: Momiji
message: （So fast...！）
Before I knew it, she had lunged forward and was already swinging her blade right in front of me. I didn't even have the chance to retort with, "I mean that I'll be the one to win."
Without pausing, Victoria immediately twisted her body and rained down a flurry of strikes on me.

name: Victoria
message: 「Keep it coming！ Everyone, make sure you're watching！」
Sweeping strikes, diagonal slashes, thrusts, and even attacks aimed at my feet. I barely managed to dodge or parry the wide array of attacks she unleashed.
And with every single one of them, both their speed and power were far greater than before.
Even dodging them had become a hair's breadth affair, and just parrying them required a significant amount of strength.

name: Momiji
message: （As I thought... in short, Victoria gets stronger the more spectators there are.）
I could finally grasp the reason why Sensei said I couldn't beat Victoria like this.
The more people watching, the higher her Mental Resonance Coefficient jumps—that is the characteristic of Victoria's Tenju.
It sends shivers down my spine to think what would happen if this were the main tournament.

name: Victoria
message: 「Come on, Suzakuin, you have to counterattack more！ Let's get the crowd pumped up！」

name: Momiji
message: 「You certainly talk like it's easy...！」
I'm barely hanging on just trying to survive your onslaught！

name: Momiji
message: 「Ugh... at this rate...！」
Even though it wasn't a finishing move, a strike I failed to dodge grazed my body, whittling down my Barrier Jacket.
Perhaps because she's so focused on putting on a show, Victoria's movements are quite rough.
But thanks to an improvement in her abilities that more than compensates for that, just blocking her attacks is a struggle.
If I let her keep rampaging like this, I’m going to lose.
Just as Sensei said, I have no choice but to go for a one-hit finish.
Including all the information I”ve gathered so far and the Plan B she showed in this match, I have more or less "figured out" Victoria.
Her sword techniques, telegraphing motions, combat range, tactical algorithms, offensive and defensive skills, common routines, combination patterns, and the probability of their usage.
It’s not enough, but for now, this will suffice.

name: Momiji
message: （...Shingan no Kiwamete, initiate）
Now, I can read Victoria’s blade trajectory completely.
――Though, I won’t need that many.

name: Momiji
message: （That’s right, two moves are enough）
Dodge, then strike. That is all. I will pour every ounce of my energy into that.

name: Victoria
message: 「Here I come, I’m gonna go all out nowww！！」

name: Momiji
message: 「Guh, ngh...！」
As I parry Victoria’s attacks, I frantically push forward with my calculations.
Only two moves—that is precisely why the pattern formation and the derivation of the optimal move must be perfect. There is no room for error. I have to settle this in one go.

name: Momiji
message: （The path to my victory is... this one...！）
I leapt far backward.
Once I had put some distance between us, I spoke to Victoria, who was about to give chase.

name: Momiji
message: 「That’s a shame, everyone is watching us, you know」

name: Victoria
message: 「Yes！ That’s how a match should be, after all！」

name: Momiji
message: 「But if that’s the case, don’t you think it’s a little sad to end it with a simple brawl like this？」

name: Momiji
message: 「If we’re going to do this, shouldn’t we do it with more flair？」

name: Victoria
message: 「Oh！ You’re starting to get it too, Suzakuin-chan～！」

name: Victoria
message: 「In that case, maybe I’ll go with some flair！」
Taking the bait from my goading, she once again struck that pose for her finishing move.
I responded to it by taking up my stance once again――

name: Shizuku
message: （What？ That was strange...）
Something about Suzakuin’s reaction bothered me.

name: Shizuku
message: （Why would she suddenly say something like that...？ She doesn’t seem like that type of person at all）
She had never tried to play to the crowd before, and she certainly wouldn’t have goaded an opponent.
And yet, what exactly is she aiming for...?

name: Victoria
message: 「Listen well and hear me！ You insolent, rude, and uncultured ruffians who dare to bear a grudge against the Shogun！」
Vicky began her usual prologue.
With her energy levels spiked, her Tenju is surging; even someone like Suzakuin shouldn’t be able to withstand it.

name: Victoria
message: 「Now that this Okita-kun has arrived, I won’t let you do as you please！」

name: Victoria
message: 「Our Tennen Rishin-ryuu is the number one sword art in the realm！！」
Even more so, she hadn't been able to dodge the six-hit combo from earlier. If that was the case, there’s no way she could survive Vicky’s current barrage――

name: Shizuku
message: （…Wait？ Don't tell me… no way！）

name: Victoria
message: 「I’m feeling… nine Katanas today！！！」
Vicky raises even more blades than before. She’s undoubtedly in peak condition, but right now—！

name: Shizuku
message: 「Vicky, wait！ Not now！」
I call out in a panic. But—
Victoria is coming at me with nine blades.
I don’t think I can dodge all of those strikes, not at this speed and power.
But this is fine—this is what I was waiting for.

name: Momiji
message: （I don’t have to dodge them all. I just need one split second！）

name: Victoria
message: 「Yugen Mugen, Sonic Ruuuush！！！」
A blindingly fast flurry of stabs, raining down like a summer shower.
But conversely, that makes it a desperate, all-out move that ignores all defense.

name: Momiji
message: 「Urgh…！」
A chunk of my side is gouged out. But I’m still here.
With not even a hair’s breadth to spare, I weave through the gaps in the triple-thrust strikes.

name: Momiji
message: 「Ugh…！」
A blade pierces the air just millimeters from my temple. A few strands of hair fall away.
Keep going—！！
In the slight opening amidst the continuous stabs—
I dive headlong into the storm of steel, my Barrier Jacket being shredded as I flash my own blade.
Faster even than Victoria’s nine―fold thrust―！

name: Momiji
message: 「Secret Technique, Swallow Triple―Strike―！！！」
The first strike gouges into Victoria’s Barrier Jacket, just as aimed.
The second strike traces that same gouge—

name: Victoria
message: 「Nooooouuuu…！！！」
The final flash sucks into the exact same spot, without a hair’s difference.

name: Umpire
message: 「That’s it！！」

name: Momiji
message: 「Hah, hah… haaaah…！」

name: Umpire
message: 「……Winner, Suzakuin Momiji！！！」
And just like that, I—I had defeated Victoria.
After the match ended and the spectators had dispersed.

name: Victoria
message: 「Hey Suzakuin-chan！ That last bit was amazing！」
Victoria-san said, rushing over to me.

name: Momiji
message: 「Um, are you referring to the final triple swallow strike？」

name: Victoria
message: 「That’s it! I’m sure I attacked first, but you came back with a combo faster than that—slash, slash, slash!—and I was like, ‘what just happened?!’」

name: Victoria
message: 「I really thought that Sonic Rush would be the end of it, too.」

name: Momiji
message: 「If I had just taken it normally, it would have been the end.」

name: Momiji
message: 「But, I’ve seen the three-stage thrust many times before. I judged that there was still a chance for victory within it.」

name: Momiji
message: 「It was a battle of speed―a little gamble―to see who would deplete the other’s Barrier Jacket first.」
Even so, I believed that I could win.
Just as Shizuku-san was there to support Victoria-san, I had people who supported me and believed in my victory, too.

name: Victoria
message: 「I see! As expected, Suzakuin-chan is strong!」

name: Momiji
message: 「Thank you. You were strong as well, Victoria-san.」

name: Victoria
message: 「Hehe, thanks♪」

name: Victoria
message: 「Oh, right！ So, what are you planning to do in the future, Suzakuin-chan？」

name: Momiji
message: 「Well, it’s hard to say, but I haven't really decided on anything yet…」

name: Victoria
message: 「Then come join my team！ The professional Jindou team I’m setting up！！」
While Jindou is primarily an individual sport, professional athletes sometimes form teams to improve the efficiency of facilities and equipment.
Securing training grounds, nurturing successors, and management are all handled in-house there as well.

name: Victoria
message: 「Come on, wouldn’t that be great？ We could invite all the other strong people too, like an ultimate party of rivals from back in school！」

name: Momiji
message: 「Victoria-san, Iori-sensei told you before to go through him for recruiting, didn't he?」

name: Victoria
message: 「Huh? Did he? I don’t remember that~」

name: Victoria
message: 「Well, regardless, it’s the person’s feelings that matter, right？ That’s why I want to know what you think, Suzakuin-chan！」

name: Momiji
message: 「I am honored by the invitation, but unfortunately, I have no intention of becoming a professional Jindou athlete.」

name: Victoria
message: 「Muu… I see. That’s a shame, but I guess it can't be helped.」

name: Victoria
message: 「Besides, if I force you to join when you say you don’t want to, it wouldn't make for a fun team, would it?」

name: Victoria
message: 「To show everyone a heated battle, motivation—passion—is what matters most of all！」

name: Momiji
message: 「Hehe, that might very well be true」

name: Victoria
message: 「In exchange, tell me the secret to your strength, Suzakuin-chan！ Pretty please, teach me！！」

name: Momiji
message: 「W-what is it, so suddenly」

name: Victoria
message: 「If I can't have Suzakuin-chan, then at least I want to input that strength into the team！」

name: Victoria
message: 「Everyone in the Suzakuin family is strong, right？ There must be some kind of secret to it, right？」

name: Momiji
message: 「Secret, well... we do have a creed.」

name: Victoria
message: 「A creeeeed？」

name: Momiji
message: 「'Self-reliance.' We don't use a Second; from forging our own blades to adjusting our Origami, we handle it all on our own.」

name: Momiji
message: 「The goal is to strive to become a self-sufficient swordsman.」

name: Victoria
message: 「Whoaaa…！ What’s that, amazing！ That’s so cool, like, a lone wolf swordsman！？」

name: Momiji
message: 「Well, if you want to put it coolly, that’s what it is…」

name: Victoria
message: 「I see~! So it means aiming to be a perfect person who doesn't rely on anyone and does everything all by themselves!」

name: Victoria
message: 「I like that~! It's so Okita-kun-like! Maybe I should try that too~」

name: Victoria
message: 「Until now, I’ve left all the little details to Shizu, but that’s probably not good, it’s not cool at all.」

name: Victoria
message: 「From now on, I’m going to make and prepare my own Origami！」

name: Momiji
message: 「N-no, but Minamoto-senpai is very excellent as a Second, so…」

name: Victoria
message: 「Of course Shizu is super excellent！」

name: Victoria
message: 「But hey, if I want to be a full-fledged swordsman like Okita-kun, I have to be able to handle things more on my own, you know.」

name: Victoria
message: 「From now on, I’m going to be self-reliant too! I’ll do everything myself, and I’ll be more Suzakuin-like than Suzakuin-chan!」

name: Victoria
message: 「And then I’ll defeat Suzakuin-chan！ Whew~！ Everyone’s gonna be fired up for this for sure~！」

name: Momiji
message: 「Um, weren't we supposed to be forming a team？」

name: Victoria
message: 「Hehe, that's for after we go pro, right！」
Victoria-san said that with an innocent laugh.
I could only smile wryly, but—

name: Momiji
message: （…Huh？ Is that… over there…）
When I noticed, Minamoto-senpai was standing a little way off.
And for some reason—she was casting a dark look in my direction.
